models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description:
This project is a machine learning classification model built to predict whether a Netflix title is a Movie or a TV Show based on its release year.

The dataset is taken from Netflix and contains information about various shows and movies including title, director, cast, country, rating, and release year.
models.title: Netflix Analysis Model

models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description: This project is a machine learning classification model designed to predict customer spending behavior based on demographic and financial information. The goal is to classify customers into different spending segments such as High Spender, Medium Spender, and Low Spender.
models.title: Mall Customer Segmentation Model

models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description:
This project is a machine learning model built to predict whether a passenger survived the sinking of the RMS Titanic.

The model uses passenger information such as age, gender, ticket class, fare, family size, and boarding location to learn patterns that influenced survival during the disaster.
models.title: Titanic Survival Prediction Model

models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description: A Decision Tree Classification model that predicts the winner of an IPL match based on match details such as season, city, venue, participating teams, toss winner, toss decision, target runs, target overs, super over status, and umpires. The model is built using Scikit-learn and evaluated using standard classification metrics.
models.title: IPL Analysis Model

models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description: A Logistic Regression classification model built on a COVID-19 dataset to predict patient outcomes based on the available features. The project includes preprocessing, model training, performance evaluation, and saving the trained model for future predictions.
models.title: Covid-19 Model

models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description: This project uses a Linear Regression model to predict student results using features such as the number of courses, time studied, and marks. The model is trained using Scikit-learn and can make predictions based on user input.
models.title: Student Marks Analysis Model

models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description: This project uses a Linear Regression algorithm to predict house prices from property features including bedrooms, bathrooms, living area, lot area, and floors. The dataset is preprocessed, the model is trained using Scikit-learn, and the trained model is saved using Joblib for making future predictions.
models.title: House Price Prediction Model

models.author: Bhawana Hada
models.description:
This project implements a Decision Tree Classifier to predict the FIFA World Cup Winner based on historical tournament data. The dataset includes features such as tournament year, host country, runners-up, third and fourth-place teams, goals scored, qualified teams, matches played, and attendance.

The preprocessing steps include handling categorical variables using label encoding and converting numerical fields into the appropriate data types. The data is then split into training and testing sets to evaluate the model's performance.
models.title: FIFA Player Prediction Model

models.author: 蜻蛉切雷切村正おうち太公望
models.description:
# Tonbokiri-Gemma-chan

自作小説の解説対談JSONでQLoRA微調整した、作品Q&A批評家Gemma。

V5推奨

Variations:

  v1-tonbokiri-qa-critic   : （3ep/R16）未完成

  v2-tonbokiri-qa-epo5     : 情感過剰（5ep/R16）ペルソナ暴走注意

  v3-tonbokiri-qa-ep5lr32  : 過学習（5ep/R32）ループ注意

  v4

  v5-tonbokiri-qa-yowa800 :弱学習

## スペック
- Base: google/gemma-2-2b-jpn-it
- Method: QLoRA (4bit)
- Samples: 228 (8作品バランス補正済み)
- V1Loss: 3.89 → 2.04( Epoch3)
- V2Loss: 4.03 ->1.30( Epoch5)
- V3Loss 4.03 ->1.30 (Epoch5 LORA_R=32)
- V5Loss 4.77 ->3.18 (Epoch3 貧弱学習)
## 使い方
1. google/gemma-2-2b-jpn-it を読み込み
2. このアダプタを PeftModel.from_pretrained で合体
3. SYSTEMプロンプトで「公式解説AI」として喋らせる
models.title: Tonbokiri-Gemma-chan
